detail.longDescription: Over a decade after starting LinuxOnAndroid on XDA, the project is officially back! Local LLMs took care of the repetitive boilerplate so I could focus entirely on the fun engineering: PRoot environments and running modern Linux distros on mobile hardware. Watch on PeerTube: https:// tube.devwithzachary.com/w/uc8h NAD5V5PgJRa8z2o534 Watch on YouTube: https:// youtu.be/-p0SzpiHGS4 # Linux # Android # PRoot # OpenSource # LocalLLM # SelfHosted # DevCommunity
